## Integers
:::

| | |
| --- | --- |
| [Integers](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mcs/chapters/direct-proof.html#def-integers), rationals, [reals](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mcs/chapters/sets.html#def-real-numbers) | $\bbZ$, $\bbQ$, $\bbR$ |
| [Even](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mcs/chapters/direct-proof.html#def-even-odd) | $n = 2 k$ for some $k \in \bbZ$ |
| [Odd](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mcs/chapters/direct-proof.html#def-odd) | $n = 2 k + 1$ for some $k \in \bbZ$ |
| Parity | every integer is even or odd, and none is both |
| Closure | $a + b$, $a - b$ and $a b$ are integers |
| [Divides](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mcs/chapters/direct-proof.html#def-divides) | $a \mid b$ if $b = a k$ for some $k \in \bbZ$ |
| [Congruence](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mcs/chapters/contrapositive-contradiction.html#def-congruence) ($n > 0$) | $a \equiv b \pmod{n}$ if $n \mid (a - b)$ |
| Remainder $r$ of $a$ by $n > 0$ | unique $q, r \in \bbZ$ with $a = q n + r$, $0 \le r < n$ |
| [Rational](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mcs/chapters/contrapositive-contradiction.html#def-rational-numbers) | $x = a / b$ for some $a, b \in \bbZ$, $b \ne 0$ |

: Integers. {#tbl-ns-integers tbl-colwidths="[42,58]"}
